label: PRELIMINARY - model not yet qualified (A0018 MAP ensemble; A0015)

model_samples.primary: window 'post': all 24 L-BFGS optima (24/24 line-search termination at a common mode, lp spread 0.3)
model_samples.sensitivity: window 'full': all 24 L-BFGS optima (23 line-search + 1 converged; 3 within 10 lp of best; distinct modes) - per-sample results kept so the 3 top-lp modes can be summarised separately

post.horizon_rule: 2 x fitted window length (3.88 s, A0018 window 'post') in model ms

ez_estimate.rule: top1 = argmax median x0 over optima; EZ set = fraction of optima with x0 > -2.06 above 0.5 (empty -> [top1])

full.horizon_rule: 2 x fitted window length (7.20 s, A0018 window 'full') in model ms

ez_estimate.rule: top1 = argmax median x0 over optima; EZ set = fraction of optima with x0 > -2.06 above 0.5 (empty -> [top1])

model_samples.parameter_transfer: x0 (162) inserted unchanged into SpatEpiStim (paper VBT workflow); coupling a = 0.1 * K (package Heaviside default scaled by the 2D-fit K relative to its prior mean 1); 2D tau0 and z_init not transferred (different model time scale/state); all other SpatEpiStim constants package defaults

objectives: reduce total seizure duration summed over regions
reduce SEEG channels with log-power > baseline-window mean + 3 SD
cost: regions removed (surgery) / stimulation amplitude (model units)

controls.no_intervention: paired baseline per sample (same x0, K, initial state, horizon, integrator, noise seed)
controls.sham: not run separately: STIM arms at amplitude 0 are identical to baseline (deterministic model)
controls.clinically_delivered: the P2 recording itself contains a 50 Hz SEEG train 0.5-3.5 s (A0009); STIM-PT reproduces this protocol as the diagnostic arm; no clinical intervention exists for the virtual patient

uncertainty_sampling: MAP-ensemble optima (not posterior draws): spread across optima reported as median and 5-95% interval; final run on NUTS draws when a converged bundle exists
stopping_criteria: one SimulationBatch covering all candidates on all optima of both windows by 16:45 UTC; if time runs out, the primary window is committed and the sensitivity window is reported as not run
